mentions.name: UltiMidi
mentions.description: A music game platform the author is almost ready to release, where players play mini-games with a real instrument. It currently supports piano, with plans to add guitar and ukulele, possibly drums, and more mini-games including rhythm games. It builds on the author's earlier neural-network work detecting which guitar string and fret was played.
mentions.source_excerpt: now I'm almost ready to release https://ultimidi.com , check it out, it's not really a rhythm game, but my goal is to add more mini-games to it (including rhythm games) and more instruments (now has piano, but planning to add guitar, ukulele too, not sure if drums would work too).
